file_purpose: Replication record for the engine-acoustics synthesizer. It is not a trained evaluator, so there is no held-out score.
experiment_name: four-stroke engine synthesis and order tracking

physics.cycle: Four-stroke. Each cylinder fires once per 720 degrees of crank.

modes.hybrid: Pulses, resonant orders, and band-limited aspiration noise. This is the default.

order_tracking: Angular resampling onto a uniform crank grid, then an order FFT. Ridges follow order * RPM(t) / 60.
